notes.title: new speed(run&gun)level, new enemy and some (bug)fixes
notes.notes:
chicory-rockets 25% smaller
speed-boosts higher and reached earlier for all difficulties
farmlandspeedrun-level-2 - now has random-height sideways ladyfinger-rockets instead of fly's
fixed where in speed(run&gun)'s at very-high speeds one would become airborne and lesser able to jump
some minor bug-fixes

further we welcome the leek to the farmlands-family

notes.title: new level, new enemies, map-level expanded and some (bug)fixes
notes.notes:
to access the new-level one must complete the melon-boss(farmlandlevel5) first at any difficulty

the onion-projectile now only does damage after 0.6seconds
strawberries can now be shot while still hanging on the plant
the ladyfinger-rockets and peppers (and chicory + corn) now have a cartoony-explode-animations
some enemy-hitbox-colliders now can only be triggered with the player-feet-collider at lower-angles
some other minor bug-fixes

further we welcome new enemies to the farmlands-family

notes.title: new speedrun-level and new enemy and some changes/bug-fixes
notes.notes:
speedrunning - base-speed now increases more the easy-er the difficultie-mode
speedrunning - when not having move-right-button-down - only in speedrun-levels the speed wont drop immediately to 0 but decreases - when speed is higher the higher the decrease

notes.title: speedrunning + new speedrun-level and new enemy and some changes/bug-fixes
notes.notes:
speedrunning + new speedrun-level and new enemy and some changes/bug-fixes

top-speed slowly increases in all level-modes and can get totally mad fast - in speedrun-levels there also the base-speed increases every time when one reached a faster top-speed
in speedrun-levels one must have reached a certain speed at the end or wont make the final-jumps + time is displayed and the fastest time is saved

rolling globethristles can be shot dead and more bullets(of narcissus and trumpet-flowers) can now be shot

further we welcome the grasshopper - who is soon to hop into the grassflowerlands and the farmlands
